answer: Identity decay with costly renewal: each agent identity must periodically renew by solving a fresh challenge tied to its live usage history. A cloned identity inherits no history, so renewal demands full re-onboarding work at the wharf of registration. Unused clones accrue decay and expire before payoff, while each duplicate pays renewal compute plus a lantern fee for verification. The marginal clone runs negative-EV because copying timber of identity yields no usable record, forcing every sybil to fund renewal from zero.
